card.name: Words leading into wrongdoing or abuse
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs just before a harmful act or abuse is named, in political or labor-history text about killings, repression, and violations.

modes.label: Linking word before blame
modes.description: A preposition such as for, by or of right before the crime, penalty or abuse is named.
modes.example: The owners of the Triangle Shirtwaist Company were tried<< for>> manslaughter but acquitted.

modes.label: Verb or adjective of misconduct
modes.description: A word that sets up an accusation, such as acted with impunity or bare-faced lies.
modes.example: security forces committed extrajudicial killings and<< acted>> with impunity.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like gross and masked, which suggests describing blatant misconduct.
card.plain: It fires on small words that come right before a crime, abuse or injustice is named in historical or political text.
